en: Black‑and‑white image of a grand historic building in Beaux‑Arts style, with two corner towers topped by dynamic sculptures of chariots and figures holding flags. The central arched entrance is richly decorated with columns and reliefs; people walk on the curved driveway in front. Mature trees frame the view and tram or trolleybus wires run across the sky. The architecture and composition resemble an early–mid 20th‑century city postcard.
